lines.text: Your money leaves your account. The transaction says successful. But the person you're paying never receives it. Now what?
Meet Resolve. An AI-powered platform that helps you investigate financial problems, prepare complaints, and take the next step toward getting your money back.
Simply tell Resolve what happened. Provide your transaction details, and upload the evidence.
Resolve analyses your complaint, organises the evidence, and helps you understand what likely went wrong, and what to do next.
It then prepares a structured complaint, with the information your bank needs to review the issue.
But Resolve doesn't stop at generating a report. It helps you identify where to send your complaint, and supports submitting it through available bank channels.
And once your complaint is submitted, Resolve helps you keep track of the process, understand responses from your bank, and know what to do next.
Resolve. Turning financial complaints into actionable next steps.
